reason: I have 11-20 techs and a POS that mostly works. Moving my client list, staff and card processing to a new system is a real risk on a busy Saturday, and the $39 a month isn't what I'm weighing. The trial next to my old system is fair, but running two systems with a full team is a hassle.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is. At my volume a small difference in rate is worth far more than the $49 a month, and I've heard 'cheaper' from every processing rep who walks in. I want to see my own statements run first, and a founding-salon app with no track record could break checkout with 15 techs waiting.
would_change_my_mind: A free fee check on my own 3 months of statements showing a clearly lower yearly cost in writing, plus a call with another big salon (10+ techs, not a 3-chair shop) that has run it for months without checkout going down.
